parts.problem_md:
An image has been changed in a number of different ways.

Original image

![Black arrow-shaped design pointing right on a white background, with angular edges and a bold appearance.](assets/001-black-arrow-shaped-design-pointing-right-on-a-wh.png)

For each of the following images **describe **the software editing technique used in order to produce the edited images shown from the original image.

Edited images

![Four geometric arrow shapes labelled A to D; A is the smallest black right-pointing arrow, B is a large upwards-pointing arrow, C is a large left-pointing arrow, D is grey.](assets/002-four-geometric-arrow-shapes-labelled-a-to-d-a-is.png)
parts.solution_md:
The editing techniques used in order to produce the edited images shown are:

**A**

- Resize the image maintaining aspect ratio **[1 mark]**

**B**

- Rotate the image 90 degrees anti clockwise/counter clockwise **OR **270 degrees clockwise **[1 mark]**

**C**

- Reflect the image in the Y axis **[1 mark]**

**D**

- Brightness adjusted **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A student has taken a photograph of him and his friend, using a digital camera. He needs to increase the size of the image to include it on a poster.

He now wishes to edit the image to remove his friend. He edits the image by cropping it and removing part of the image.

**Describe**, step by step, how he would crop the image.
parts.solution_md:
To crop the image, the student would need to:

Any **five **of the following:

- Open graphics/image editing software **[1 mark]**
- Load/import the image **[1 mark]**
- Select the image **[1 mark]**
- Click crop **[1 mark]**
- Click an edge/crop handle of the image **[1 mark]**
- Click and drag the edge/crop handle inwards … **[1 mark]**
- …until cropped area appears **[1 mark]**
- Click done/finish **[1 mark]**
- Save the image **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
An image has been taken of a bird watcher and a bird. The original image has been saved as a jpg file type. You have been asked to remove parts of the image to just show the bird and to save it as a png file type to become the new image.

![Photographer in hat capturing a bird perched on a rocky ledge with long grass, under a clear sky.](assets/003-photographer-in-hat-capturing-a-bird-perched-on-.png)

**Original Image**

![Bird perched on a rocky outcrop with sparse grass, set against a clear grey sky. The scene conveys a sense of solitude and natural simplicity.](assets/004-bird-perched-on-a-rocky-outcrop-with-sparse-gras.png)

**New Image**

**Explain **the steps needed to change the original image to the new image
parts.solution_md:
To change the original image into the new images the following steps have been taken:

Any **four **of the following:

- Load the image/photo editing software **[1 mark]**
- Load/import the image **[1 mark]**
- Click on image **[1 mark]**
- Click on crop **[1 mark]**
- Move arrows to select area to be cropped/Draw around the area to be cut out **[1 mark]**
- Click on delete/Click outside the image **[1 mark]**
- Select Save As/export and then select png format **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Many word processing packages have a number of formatting features

The paragraph below shows some of the formatting features that can be used.

![Text announcing Northshire Steam Railway's Summer Steam Festival 2022, featuring new steam engines and the Teal Steam Crane as attractions.](assets/005-text-announcing-northshire-steam-railway-s-summe.png)

The logo for the Summer Steam Festival is shown and labelled A. The organisers of the event are planning to create a second logo for all their correspondence. This is shown and labelled B.

![Two rectangular badges labelled A and B, featuring "Summer Steam Festival 2022" text above a train icon. Badge A is light, Badge B is dark.](assets/006-two-rectangular-badges-labelled-a-and-b-featurin.png)

Describe the steps that have been used to transform logo A into logo B.
parts.solution_md:
Steps that have been used to transform logo A into logo B include:

Any **four **of the following:

- Click on the shape/logo A **[1 mark]**
- Slide the corners in to reduce the size of the shape/logo **[1 mark]**
- Keep the aspect ratio **OR **type in the height and width **[1 mark]**
- Fill the shape/logo with black **[1 mark]**
- Highlight the text **[1 mark]**
- Reduce the size of the text **[1 mark]**
- Change the colour of the text to white **[1 mark]**
- Click on the image/train **[1 mark]**
- Reduce the height and width **OR **reduce the size of the image/train **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A student has taken a photograph of him and his friend, using a digital camera. He needs to increase the size of the image to include it on a poster.

**Give **one disadvantage of increasing the size of this image.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of disadvantages of increasing the size of the image include:

Any **one **of the following:

- Can cause pixelation **[1 mark]**
- Lose some of the resolution/image quality reduced **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
gif and jpg file formats are used to store images

The file size of an image can be reduced by changing the file format of the image

**State **two other ways of reducing the file size of an image.
parts.solution_md:
Other ways of reducing the file size of an image include:

Any **two** of the following:

- Change the resolution/quality of the image **[1 mark]**
- Reduce the colour/bit depth **[1 mark]**
- Change the compression method **OR **Compress the file Reduce layers **[1 mark]**
